summary_1line: After Indrajit’s death, Lakshmana returns wounded; Rama warmly praises and embraces him, declaring Ravana effectively defeated and preparing for the final confrontation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama tenderly embraces the blood‑stained Lakshmana, seating him on his lap while the monkey chiefs gather around after Indrajit’s defeat.
In the heavens, gods beat their gongs and apsaras scatter showers of flowers as Indrajit’s lifeless body lies on the battlefield.
Lakshmana, wounded and supported by Hanuman and Vibhishana, returns from battle surrounded by jubilant monkeys leaping and clapping.
